source: Three published rankings read on 6 October 2026: Headphonesty reader vote (August 2026), Slant 25/20 poll (30 June 2002), Resident Advisor Best Electronic Records of 2000-25 (2025). Years and labels from MusicBrainz release data. Every Spotify album ID was checked by oEmbed (status 200, title matched) on 6 October 2026.
note: Thirteen of the sixteen are on two lists or by an artist on two; three (Music for Airports, Boy in da Corner, Double Cup) are top-ten placings kept for range. Not a canon from memory. Trans-Europe Express (Kraftwerk, 1977, Capitol per MusicBrainz, Slant number 1) and Oxygene (Headphonesty number 1) are named and not embedded: no Spotify album ID was confirmed for them. Independent review 6 Oct 2026. Four images, all openly licensed and downloaded locally: Kraftwerk (CC BY-SA 3.0, Andréas Hagström), Massive Attack (CC BY 2.0, Festival Eurockeennes), Underworld (CC BY 2.0, Phil Whitehouse), Daft Punk (CC BY 4.0, Sony Music Entertainment). None is used on another guide.
